{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.32

|gr1= GUI Control - Object

|descr= Sets orientation of 3D control model. It is similar to [[setVectorDirAndUp]] command for an object.

|s1= control [[ctrlSetModelDirAndUp]] dirAndUp

|p1= control : [[Control]] - 3D control

|p2= dirAndUp: [[Array]] with [vectorDir, vectorUp]
* vectorDir: [[Vector3D]] - see [[vectorDir]]
* vectorUp: [[Vector3D]] - see [[vectorUp]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_ctrl3D ctrlSetModelDirAndUp [[0,1,0],[0,0,1]]; //default orientation</sqf>

|seealso= [[ctrlModelDirAndUp]] [[ctrlCreate]] [[ctrlDelete]] [[ctrlModel]] [[ctrlSetModel]] [[ctrlModelScale]] [[ctrlSetModelScale]] [[ctrlPosition]] [[ctrlSetPosition]] [[ctrlClassName]] [[vectorDir]] [[vectorUp]] [[setVectorDirAndUp]] [[ctrlModelVectorSide]]
}}
